subject.title: fix(agents): xAI/Grok requests fail after a stale reasoning replay ("could not decrypt encrypted_content")

question: Should this PR satisfy the real-behavior proof gate with pre-fix production logs plus source-level positive/negative retry tests because the exact xAI rotation error is not inducible on demand?
rationale: ClawSweeper cannot verify the provider-side rotation path from source alone, but waiting for organic xAI key rotation may indefinitely stall a narrow P1 outage fix.

options.title: Accept a proof override
options.body: Treat the redacted pre-fix logs, existing live-proven sibling retry path, CI, and focused predicate tests as sufficient for this non-inducible provider error.

options.title: Wait for organic after-fix logs
options.body: Keep the PR blocked until a future xAI rotation produces redacted gateway output showing the retry succeeds after this branch.

options.title: Close and reopen later
options.body: Close this PR as not currently proveable and ask for a fresh PR when real post-fix xAI evidence is available.

recommendation.title: Accept a proof override
recommendation.body: Treat the redacted pre-fix logs, existing live-proven sibling retry path, CI, and focused predicate tests as sufficient for this non-inducible provider error.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored and merged the sibling encrypted reasoning retry path and are the clearest owner for deciding whether this proof exception is acceptable.
